observations: Mesh back office chair with a headrest and armrests.
The backrest is tilted back to a near-horizontal position in the photo.
Five-star chrome base with black casters.
Adjustable armrests with visible release buttons.
The seller describes it as 'Bent', which matches the visual state of the backrest.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the backrest reclined at an extreme angle

risks.risk: The recline mechanism or backrest support may be snapped or unable to lock upright.
risks.proof: Video showing the chair being moved from reclined to a locked upright position.

risks.risk: The gas lift cylinder may be failed, preventing height adjustment.
risks.proof: Video showing the chair rising and lowering via the lever.

risks.risk: The mesh may be sagging or detached from the frame under weight.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the mesh attachment points.

proof_requests: Video showing the chair locking firmly in an upright sitting position.
Video demonstrating the gas lift height adjustment working.
Clear photo of the underside of the seat to check the adjustment mechanism condition.
response.reason: The chair is pictured with the backrest at an extreme angle. Without proof that it can lock upright, it appears broken rather than functional.
